data_cards.title: DCC Eligibility Checklist for Indians Posted to the UK
data_cards.catch_text: Family members who take UK jobs are not covered — they pay UK NICs under normal rules.

steps.step: Confirm you are a detached worker
steps.detail: You are sent temporarily by your India-based employer; independent moves to a UK employer do not qualify.

steps.step: Check the assignment length
steps.detail: The expected UK stay must not exceed 60 months.

steps.step: Get a Certificate of Coverage from EPFO
steps.detail: This is the proof UK payroll and HMRC rely on for NIC exemption.

steps.step: Keep paying into India's EPF
steps.detail: Contributions continue at a similar level to UK NICs under Article 8(7).

steps.step: Budget visa costs separately
steps.detail: The DCC does not waive visa fees, the Immigration Health Surcharge or the Immigration Skills Charge.
